latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: AI-powered platform for generating and exporting 1080p short-form video clips from raw footage via simple text prompts.
- Supports quick editing, vertical aspect ratio for Shorts/TikTok, captions, transitions, BGM, and batch workflows.
- No timeline editing or export settings required; all editing and rendering performed remotely on GPU nodes.
- Simple onboarding: uses environment token or provides free starter token for new users.
- Includes robust error handling, credit system, and immediate onboarding workflow.
- Accepts major video, image, and audio file formats up to 500MB.
